resource_risks.description: Runtime source catalog refresh could scan too much workspace data or expose local-only/sensitive directories.
resource_risks.mitigation: The Tauri command skips private, output, VCS, dependency, build, cache, and symlink entries; caps scanned entries and returned results; and only includes known text/code extensions.

resource_risks.description: Multiple open source drafts and Monaco editor/diff models could grow client-side memory if unbounded.
resource_risks.mitigation: The runtime file browser renders a capped filtered catalog, open draft state is explicit and closable by tab, and large files use the existing maximum file read/write boundary.

resource_risks.description: Save All writes multiple files and could leave file handle or backup-state risk if not using bounded Tauri calls.
resource_risks.mitigation: Save All iterates dirty drafts through the existing workspace-scoped write command, which writes backups and returns a report per file without persistent handles.
